---
title: Cheese Puff Pastries
id: MAR-0071
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 60
difficulty: medium
---
## Ingredients
- 250 g puff pastry
- 150 g Pecorino Romano
- 100 g Grana Padano
- 4 whole eggs
- 1 egg yolk
## Method
1. Crack 3 eggs into a bowl, add the egg yolk, salt, pepper, and beat with a fork.
2. Add the cheeses and mix.
3. Crack the remaining egg, separating the yolk from the whites.
4. Roll out the pastry into a thin sheet and cut out discs of 8 cm with a cookie cutter.
5. Place the cheese filling in the center of half of the discs, brush the edges with lightly beaten egg white, and cover with the other half of the discs, pressing the edges to seal.
6. Place the pastries on the baking sheet lined with parchment paper, brush the surface with the yolk, and bake in the oven at 180 °C for 15-20 minutes.
